records.title: Cinema, Seating Capacity And Attendances, Annual

row.footnote: Data refer to the total number of projection screens in each hall across all cinemas.  Based on data from major Singapore exhibitors, e.g., Shaw Theatres, Golden Village.  Data exclude multi-purpose venues that also exhibit films such as Capitol Theatre, Salt Media Theatre, The Esplanade Theatre, National Museum of Singapore, The Arts House, Resorts World Theatre, MBS MasterCard Theatre, Alliance Francaise, and Objectifs

Data refer to the total number of seats fitted in each hall across all cinemas.  Based on data from major Singapore exhibitors, e.g., Shaw Theatres, Golden Village.  Data exclude multi-purpose venues that also exhibit films such as Capitol Theatre, Salt Media Theatre, The Esplanade Theatre, National Museum of Singapore, The Arts House, Resorts World Theatre, MBS MasterCard Theatre, Alliance Francaise, and Objectifs.
Data refer to the total number of people who watched movies in cinemas.  Data from 2025 are obtained from an external box office data provider.  Data prior to 2025 were compiled by IMDA.
